\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\footnotesize Trimmed full sample (including usable nonconverged, unstable or noninvertible fits). Trimming removes floor(0.01 times B) replication losses from EACH tail, where B is the number of finite losses, before averaging and taking the square root. Losses are ranked separately for each method, sample size, design and accuracy measure. Accuracy is conditional on usable outputs; consult usable counts and diagnostics. Monte Carlo standard errors for trimmed accuracy statistics are not reported: the ordinary-mean formula does not account for trimming. The estimator's retained replication losses determine the paired sample; DGP losses use the same draws and are not independently trimmed. Consequently the denominator can differ from the separately plotted DGP curve.  Missing or withheld values are shown as --.\end{minipage}
